custom_logic_notes: EA declares ATR-based dynamic SL/TP/trailing variables and a MaxRiskPercent input, but the OnTick body only calls CheckTradeSignals() with a comment 'Other EA logic remains unchanged', meaning the actual trade execution, SL/TP assignment, trailing stop, and spread filter logic are incomplete/missing. The RSI value is fetched incorrectly using iRSI() as a direct return instead of CopyBuffer from the handle. The Bullish Engulfing check has a logical inconsistency: it checks Close[1]>Open[1] (bar[1] bullish) and Open[1]<Close[2] (gap condition), but does not verify bar[2] is bearish (Close[2]<Open[2]). Same issue for Bearish Engulfing. Signal fires every tick since there is no new-bar guard.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The EA uses iRSI() directly in CheckTradeSignals (line 86) instead of using the ExtIndicatorHandle with CopyBuffer - this is a bug in the source; Python conversion should use the handle-based approach (copy buffer from indicator handle). 2) Trade execution, SL/TP calculation from ATR, trailing stop, and spread filter are declared as inputs/variables but NOT implemented - Python version needs to implement these: dynamicStopLoss=ATR*multiplier, dynamicTakeProfit=ATR*multiplier, trailing stop logic when UseTrailingStop=true, and spread check against MaxSpread=20. 3) Engulfing pattern detection uses bar[1] and bar[2] (previous and prior bars) - ensure shift indexing is correct in Python (shift=1 for previous completed bar). 4) No position gate exists - add no_position check to prevent stacking. 5) Add new-bar guard to prevent repeated signals on every tick. 6) CSymbolInfo is included but never used in visible code - may be intended for spread/digit info.
